exec bash -c 'umask 077
__hermes_snap_tmp=$(mktemp /tmp/hermes-snap-__SNAPSHOT_NONCE__.sh.tmp.XXXXXXXXXX) || exit 1
{ ( unset ${!HERMES_SESSION_*} ${!HERMES_CRON_AUTO_DELIVER_*} AI_AGENT HERMES_AGENT HERMES_UI_SESSION_ID 2>/dev/null; export -p; ) || true; } > "$__hermes_snap_tmp"
__hermes_fns=$(declare -F | awk '"'"'{print $3}'"'"' | grep -vE '"'"'^_[^_]'"'"') || true
[ -n "$__hermes_fns" ] && declare -f $__hermes_fns >> "$__hermes_snap_tmp" 2>/dev/null || true
alias -p >> "$__hermes_snap_tmp"
echo '"'"'shopt -s expand_aliases'"'"' >> "$__hermes_snap_tmp"
echo '"'"'set +e'"'"' >> "$__hermes_snap_tmp"
echo '"'"'set +u'"'"' >> "$__hermes_snap_tmp"
mv -f "$__hermes_snap_tmp" /tmp/hermes-snap-__SNAPSHOT_NONCE__.sh || rm -f "$__hermes_snap_tmp"
builtin cd -- /workspace 2>/dev/null || true
printf '"'"'\n__HERMES_CWD___SNAPSHOT_NONCE____%s__HERMES_CWD___SNAPSHOT_NONCE____\n'"'"' "$(pwd -P)"
'
